texts.at-0002: Normalize money via to_money and round_money Always convert incoming monetary values with to_money() and round with round_money() from ledgerly.money before storing them on models; compare against ZERO rather than a literal.
texts.at-0003: Raise BillingError with stable error codes Reject invalid input by raising BillingError(code, detail) from ledgerly.errors, using codes like "invalid_state", "invalid_quantity" and "negative_amount" with repr() of the offending value.

item.title: Normalize datetimes with ensure_utc
item.content: In ledgerly, normalize every incoming datetime with `ensure_utc` from `ledgerly.clock` before comparing or doing arithmetic (see `current_period` in `ledgerly/subscriptions.py`). Apply it to both the argument and `sub.started_at`.

candidate.title: Raise BillingError with snake_case codes
candidate.content: Signal invalid billing inputs by raising `BillingError(code, detail)` from `ledgerly.errors` with a snake_case code string, e.g. `BillingError("invalid_period", str(sub.period_days))`, rather than ValueError or a bare exception.

item.title: Compute periods via timedelta floor division
item.content: Compute billing period boundaries the same way as `current_period` in `ledgerly/subscriptions.py`: build `length = timedelta(days=sub.period_days)` and use `n = (at - start) // length` with `start + n * length`, instead of integer day math.

source.quote:
n = (after - start) // length
    renewal = start + n * length
